introHtml: Reduce brand bowls, plates, and trays are made from reclaimed wheat straw fiber, giving your promotional products a distinct eco-friendly story. Unlike standard melamine or plastic options, these items are compostable and free of BPA, making them ideal for trade shows or company picnics where sustainability matters. Decorate with your logo using a pad print or laser engraving for a natural look that aligns with green initiatives.
